title: May The Devil Take You Too
description: Two years after escaping from a demonic terror, Alfie and Nara try to continue their lives, but Alfie is still haunted by feelings of guilt and unnatural visions.

title: Ghoul
description: A boy (Nolan Gould) and his friends seek the truth behind a sinister local legend after a teenage couple goes missing in the town cemetery.

title: The Medium
description: In the Isan region of Thailand, a shaman realizes that his nephew has been possessed. However, the goddess that appears to have taken possession turns out not to be as benevolent as she first appears.

title: Inner Demons
description: A reality show crew descends upon the home of a teenager struggling with drug addiction and uncover instead a terrifying case of demonic possession.

title: A Dark Song
description: A young woman and a damaged occultist risk their souls to perform a ritual.

title: Anything for Jackson
description: A sinister couple hatch a supernatural scheme to resurrect their dead grandson through a pregnant woman.

title: Way of the Wicked
description: When a town is swept by a series of gruesome killings, a mysterious priest (Christian Slater) seems to be the only one who can help protect them from a truth more evil than any of them could have imagined.

title: Welcome to Mercy
description: Stricken with stigmata, Madeline travels to a convent where nothing is what it seems -- and her friend August is seemingly the only person she can trust. Together, they must confront the demons inside Madeline before she becomes the Antichrist.

title: Z
description: A boy's imaginary friend terrorizes his family.

title: Nobody Gets Out Alive
description: Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.

title: Soul's Midnight
description: A man (Robert Floyd) must save his pregnant wife from a band of vampires who practice human sacrifice.

title: Asmodexia
description: In Barcelona, an exorcist (Luís Marco) and his teenage granddaughter (Clàudia Pons) cast out demons while trying to elude the grasp of the cultists who are stalking them.

title: The Vigil
description: Terror strikes when an Orthodox Jewish man agrees to watch over the dead body of a community member in a dilapidated Brooklyn home.

title: Night's End
description: After moving into a haunted apartment, a shut-in hires a stranger to perform an exorcism.

title: Voodoo Possession
description: Aiden travels to a Haitian insane asylum to find his brother and discovers all the inmates and staff are possessed by a bloodthirsty voodoo spirit.

title: I Trapped the Devil
